reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Compactor CLI flags that use the prefix `boltdb.shipper.compactor.` are removed", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: Compactor CLI flags using the boltdb.shipper.compactor. prefix are no longer recognized and will be ignored; the compactor. prefix must be used instead.
consequence.remediation: Replace all occurrences of --boltdb.shipper.compactor.* CLI flags with their --compactor.* equivalents.

proposed.statement: Compactor CLI flags with the boltdb.shipper.compactor. prefix are removed; use the compactor. prefix instead.
